title: Rav Hirsch Meets Rav Bergman
body: Rav Moshe Hillel Hirsch, Slabodka rosh yeshiva, met with Rav Meir Tzvi Bergman, Rashbi rosh yeshiva, in Bnei Brak to discuss the draft-law proposal.

title: Rav Meir Greineman Welcomes Torah
body: Rav Meir Greineman, nephew of the Chazon Ish, unveiled a newly written Sefer Torah in the Beis Medrash HaGadol in Bnei Brak, commissioned from a master sofer over the past year.
